lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to plan a path through a maze, avoiding walls, and find a short way.
In a maze, walls block the way.
Bump into one and you have to start again.
Trace the path with your finger before you add blocks.
Each straight part of the path is one block with a number.
Help the mouse through the maze to the cheese (star).
Through the twists and turns — cheese time!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
